annotations.text: First design draft authored from WK-2071 source digest sha256:e811dd7981dec180b632f6f53005103249911f93f8ebb72e7a67149d0193d124 after canonical assignment to IN-0038.
WK-2063 currently has five implementation slices: SLICE-002, SLICE-005, SLICE-006, SLICE-007, and SLICE-008; three review/redteam slices are not presumed to be integration units.

Exact target pack proof.integration.prefix-safety@1.0.0; profile digest 80afa275a69c57e9d2c4c395169851198efe043df1e097ea6cae25a2ea00f671; guarantee digest 77ffbca9bd9a063e667d13d48668f30e21236d4da2f2eb612db07cd7dc40754e.
Package code owns projection semantics; wiki-core owns server-resolved persistence and MCP owns registration/presentation. The DRY review must challenge any duplicated semantic ownership.

69/69 operative obligations are mapped exactly once to implementation-owner collections. Package-owned obligations map to buildProofAuthoringSkeleton plus executeDeterministicProjection/integrationPrefixCensus, with executeDeterministicProjection remaining the sole census/population semantic owner. Wiki-core-owned obligations map to buildProofAuthoringSkeletonOperation plus write-controlled-contract-carrier-set-v1 and manifest validation. MCP-owned obligations map to registerControlledContractTools plus controlled-contract tool discovery and bounded refusal/receipt presentation. All 69 are bound one-for-one as the complete requirement and validation population for proof.design.implementation-readiness@1.0.0; atomic settlement is additionally covered by proof.atomicity.failure-boundary@1.0.0 and forbidden CLI/arbitrary-writer invocation by proof.operation.forbidden-noninvocation@1.0.0.
